**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Build-time evaluation of {call} kept at runtime: {reason}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Nothing is required: the call runs at runtime exactly as before (only its build-time saving is lost). To get the saving, make the evaluated function deterministic (no `Date.now()`, `Math.random()`, Intl / toLocale\*, process.env, crypto) or move the varying part to a runtime argument; for a tv definition, express compound variants as plain variants, or split a definition whose variant combinations exceed the table budget.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
/** @comptime */
export function stamp(label: string) {
  return `${label}-${Date.now()}`;
}
```

```tsx prefer
/** @comptime */
export function label(name: string) {
  return `rv-${name}`;
}
```

## When it is reported

Vite builds (dev keeps every runtime call). `rivet({ comptime })` evaluates calls of allowlisted functions (tailwind-variants `tv` / `cn` / `cx`) and functions annotated `@comptime` / `@comptime tv` whose arguments are compile-time constants, in Node at build time; the evaluator traps time, randomness, locale and environment reads (during the call and while the callee's modules load), evaluates value calls twice, and proves a tv table against the real library for every enumerated combination. Any failure refuses that call or definition: it stays a runtime call, with this warning once per site.
